$comment: Single source of truth for what runs on its own. Edit a line, merge, and autonomy-reconcile.yml makes GitHub match within minutes. Every workflow file in .github/workflows must appear exactly once below (CI enforces this). Charter: docs/OPERATING_CHARTER.md

alerts.issue_title: Ops alert: autonomous stack needs attention
alerts.label: ops-alert

cold_outreach.$comment: Master switch for autonomous first-touch email. Live send needs BOTH this flag AND repo variable OWNER_LIVE_SEND=true, a clear breaker, and no pending breaker-latch approval. Switched on by the owner 2026-09-23.

launch_mode.$comment: Time-boxed loosening until first revenue (docs/OPERATING_CHARTER.md, Launch mode). Read by scripts/autonomy/launch-mode.mjs. After 'expires', or with enabled=false, every loop falls back to its normal gate. Max window 90 days (CI-enforced).

stripe_webhooks.$comment: Re-added after audit writes became fail-open (the 400s that caused the 2026-09-23 pause).

workflow_governance.$comment: Every workflow inherits its lane default. Add a complete override only when a workflow has stricter or different controls. Validated by scripts/autonomy/reconcile.mjs.

ship.evidence: Passing required checks and versioned deployment configuration
ship.permitted_action: Build, test, scan, and deploy changes through approved workflows
ship.approval_boundary: Security, revenue, schema, charter, and protected-branch decisions
ship.failure_behavior: Fail closed and report the failed check or deployment
ship.rollback: Revert the change or use the existing deployment rollback
ship.cost_cap: Existing approved CI and deployment resources only
ship.success_metric: Required checks pass and the deployed health checks are green

health.evidence: Live health probes, scheduled-run freshness, and observable system state
health.permitted_action: Monitor, open or close the defined alert, and report drift
health.approval_boundary: Infrastructure, secret, DNS, access, and production configuration changes
health.failure_behavior: Fail closed, retain evidence, and open an ops alert
health.rollback: Disable the affected loop through the switchboard
health.success_metric: Fresh probes with no unresolved health alert when systems are healthy

revenue.evidence: Verified payment, entitlement, lead, and funnel events
revenue.permitted_action: Process approved lifecycle events and report observable funnel state
revenue.approval_boundary: Prices, refunds, new SKUs, payouts, and unverified revenue claims
revenue.failure_behavior: Fail closed on missing payment or entitlement evidence and alert the owner
revenue.rollback: Disable the affected workflow and reconcile from authoritative events
revenue.cost_cap: Existing approved payment and model budgets only
revenue.success_metric: Observable progression from approved demand through provisioned value

growth.evidence: Verified contact, consent, content, and channel evidence
growth.permitted_action: Publish owned content and send only charter-compliant, gated outreach
growth.approval_boundary: Claims, unapproved audiences, spend, and policy exceptions
growth.failure_behavior: Fail closed on missing consent, opt-out, deliverability, or truth controls
growth.rollback: Disable the workflow and withdraw or correct owned content when required
growth.cost_cap: Existing approved channel and model budgets only
growth.success_metric: Qualified traffic or replies without a control breach

improve.evidence: Live source material, failed-run evidence, or measured product feedback
improve.approval_boundary: Merges, sends, charges, and production changes
improve.failure_behavior: Produce no side effect when evidence is missing or stale
improve.rollback: Disable the suggestion loop through the switchboard
improve.success_metric: Actionable, evidence-linked suggestions reviewed by the owner

repair.evidence: Reproducible failed checks and deterministic fix evidence
repair.permitted_action: Classify failures and prepare draft fixes on a branch
repair.approval_boundary: Merges and changes involving security, revenue, schema, or policy
repair.failure_behavior: Fail closed and open an alert when no deterministic repair is available
repair.rollback: Close the draft or revert the repair branch
repair.cost_cap: Existing approved CI and model budgets only
repair.success_metric: Reduced repeat failures after reviewed fixes

manual.evidence: Explicit owner invocation and the tool's documented prerequisites
manual.permitted_action: Run the requested one-shot operator tool
manual.approval_boundary: The owner invocation is the approval boundary
manual.failure_behavior: Stop before side effects when prerequisites or approval are absent
manual.rollback: Use the tool-specific documented remediation or rollback
manual.success_metric: The requested operation completes with recorded evidence

retired.rollback: Restore the retired state through the switchboard

b2b-outreach.yml.evidence: Verified or opt-in contacts, clear deliverability breaker, recordable opt-out, and approved segment
b2b-outreach.yml.permitted_action: Send a capped outreach batch only after every live-send gate passes
b2b-outreach.yml.approval_boundary: Owner live-send switch, breaker-latch resume, claims, audience exceptions, and spend
b2b-outreach.yml.failure_behavior: Force dry-run when any consent, opt-out, breaker, latch, or owner-switch control is absent
b2b-outreach.yml.rollback: Disable cold outreach or hold the breaker latch through the switchboard
b2b-outreach.yml.cost_cap: Configured daily prospect cap and existing approved provider budgets only
b2b-outreach.yml.success_metric: Qualified replies without a bounce, complaint, consent, or opt-out control breach

email-proposals.yml.evidence: Verified opportunity data and owner recipient configuration
email-proposals.yml.permitted_action: Send an internal opportunity digest to the owner
email-proposals.yml.approval_boundary: Any external recipient, proposal commitment, pricing, or send without the owner live-send switch
email-proposals.yml.failure_behavior: Force dry-run unless the owner live-send switch is explicitly enabled
email-proposals.yml.rollback: Disable the workflow through the switchboard
email-proposals.yml.success_metric: Owner receives an evidence-backed digest with no external delivery

gov-mint.yml.evidence: Verified target-chain bytecode, approved contract configuration, and a successful dry-run preflight
gov-mint.yml.permitted_action: Run dry-run mint preparation and verify target-chain deployment state
gov-mint.yml.approval_boundary: Any live transaction, wallet use, chain change, contract change, or gas spend
gov-mint.yml.failure_behavior: Refuse live minting when target bytecode or required approval is absent
gov-mint.yml.rollback: Keep dry-run enabled and disable the workflow through the switchboard
gov-mint.yml.cost_cap: Zero gas spend unless the owner explicitly approves a live transaction
gov-mint.yml.success_metric: A dry-run proves the target contract is ready without a chain write

stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.evidence: A successful production deployment and webhook events declared in the switchboard
stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.permitted_action: Add only the declared events to the declared webhook endpoint
stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.approval_boundary: Endpoint changes, event removal, undeclared webhook mutation, and Stripe credential changes
stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.failure_behavior: Plan-only on manual dispatch unless explicitly requested; otherwise stop on reconciliation failure
stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.rollback: Use the Stripe Dashboard or owner-approved reconciliation to restore the prior endpoint configuration
stripe-webhook-reconcile.yml.success_metric: Declared webhook events are present without altering undeclared endpoint configuration

ship.purpose: Push/PR-triggered build, test, security and deploy. Always on.

health.purpose: Loop 1 - read-only probes of sites, money path, schema and integrations. Opens one alert issue when red, closes it when green.

revenue.purpose: Loop 2 - warm leads to checkout, dunning, revenue report, gov digest. No cold email here.

growth.purpose: Loop 3 - owned-channel traffic (SEO, social, community listening) plus gated cold outreach.

improve.purpose: Loop 5 - Gemma (local model on the owner's LAN, self-hosted runner lan-gemma) drafts copy and outreach suggestions and triages alerts into issues. Suggestions only. Turn on after the runner is registered.

repair.purpose: Loop 4 - classify failed checks, apply deterministic fixes on a branch, open a draft PR. Never merges alone.

manual.purpose: One-shot operator tools (secret binding, backfills, manual sends). Run by hand only; state is not managed.

retired.purpose: Superseded or too costly for the value. Kept disabled so history survives; delete later if still unused.
